summary: Iteration 8 tested New Course Alerts and Course Completion Badges. Backend: 7 of 7 pytest tests pass when run serially with -n 0. The tests cover: PATCH /me/preferences updating course_emails and streak_emails independently and returning both; an empty body; 401 when logged out. Unsubscribe: a valid HMAC token returns 200 HTML and sets course_emails false; a bad or missing token returns 400 and changes nothing. Completion: 404 for an unknown id; complete and uncomplete are idempotent; the badge (kind 'course') shows in /dashboard and /public/profile/demo and goes away after uncomplete. Sync: I deleted course 584863 and triggered the cron. course_alerts for it then matched the eligible student count (6), with no row for the opted-out demo student. A second trigger added no rows. Frontend: everything passed. Logged out, the dialog has no watched button. Logged in, the button toggles between 'Mark as watched · earn badge' and 'Watched · badge earned', with a toast, the card chip and the course-watched-{id} chip. The dashboard badge shows the graduation-cap icon. /u/demo shows profile-badge-course-{id}. course-emails-toggle stays changed after a reload. Unmarking works.

minor.issue: Emails go out one by one inside the cron background task, about 0.4s per student. With many students one sync run takes a long time. The alert row is written before sending, so a failed send (e.g. 422 undeliverable) is never retried. That is acceptable but worth knowing.
Inactive (delisted) courses can still be marked as watched because the active flag is not checked. Minor.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: send course alert emails concurrently or in batches; consider rejecting completion of inactive courses.
critical_code_review_comments: sync_courses: 'fresh = [c for c in courses if known and ...]' correctly sends no alerts on the first sync (checked by reading the code; not exercised, because the DB is not empty)
There is a unique index on course_alerts(user_id, course_id), and DuplicateKeyError is caught, so alerts are never sent twice
Unsubscribe uses hmac.compare_digest and returns 400 for invalid tokens. Good.
seed_data_creation: Deleted and re-synced course 584863; its course_alerts rows were recreated. cron_runs has TEST_ ids. Final state: 13 active courses, demo course_emails=true, streak_emails=true, completions=[585979].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: pytest tests/test_course_alerts_badges.py -n 0. pytest.ini enables xdist, and parallel runs make the sync test and the completion test interfere because both use course 584863.
